newsitem.title: BELGIUM: NATO's Solana backs U.S. action in Iraq.
newsitem.headline: NATO's Solana backs U.S. action in Iraq.

text.p: NATO Secretary General Javier Solana said on Tuesday he supported U.S. military action against Iraq, calling it "a justified, measured and proportionate response."
In a statement, the North Atlantic Treaty Organisation chief called on Iraqi President Saddam Hussein to stop attacks in the region and comply with U.N. resolutions.
"Iraq has once again blatantly and gravely violated U.N. Security Council resolutions and mounted an aggressive attack against civilians inside the exclusion zone in northern Iraq," Solana said.
"Against this background the U.S. action this morning was a justified, measured and proportionate reaction," he said.

"I hope that this clear message will be heeded by Saddam Hussein and that he will immediately withdraw his forces from the area, stop any further brutal attacks, and comply fully with U.N resolutions."
